name: Vai Que Cola
description: Wanted by the police, a con man who once was a rich businessman goes hiding into a poor neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro.

videos.title: Brazilian way
videos.overview: After a year, Dona Jô decides to work on the pension. But, the money runs out and the masons rebel. The police resume investigation and discover that Valdomiro is in Meier.

videos.title: Fast and furious
videos.overview: With problems in the delivery of the warm ones, Dona Jô makes an agreement with a distant cousin, the motorcycle courier Sanderson. The taxi driver Eloisa arrives and is willing to help the owner of the pension.

videos.title: Magic Boy
videos.overview: With no money to travel, Jessica enters Máicol in the Boy Magia do Méier contest. Terezinha registers Sanderson. After a surprise, they refuse to participate in the contest.

videos.title: Marry me
videos.overview: Ferdinalva, Ferdinando's cousin, shows up at the pension, gets them all ready, and still takes Luan Santana! Wilson takes advantage of the romantic atmosphere of the singer's presence and declares himself to be Dona Jô.

videos.title: Water park
videos.overview: To cool off the infernal heat, Wilson buys a plastic swimming pool. But beyond that, the spree leaves Dona Jô's pension without water.

videos.title: Nonsense in the Pension
videos.overview: Tired of debts and guests, Dona Jô ends the perks and thinks about selling the pension. She gets an interested lady, but she doesn't realize how absurd the visit can be.

videos.title: Bubullying
videos.overview: The motorcycle courier Sanderson stutters when he is screwed by Dona Jô. With a hip hop contest close at hand, everyone tries to get him to talk like he used to.

videos.title: Powerful
videos.overview: Valdo decides to manage a show at the Imperator, the most famous house in Méier and invites Máicol to be the singer Anita's bodyguard. Eloísa taxi driver will take the singer. Jessica doesn't like this at all and goes out of her way to find out who Maicol is working for.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: Sanderson sets up a coup as everyone goes to the Halloween party. Wilson arrives in costume and notices the setup. After a cup game, strange things happen in the pension.

videos.title: Ball on the foot
videos.overview: Maicol is frustrated for not having fulfilled his dream of being a soccer player. Valdomiro has the idea of introducing Máicol to coach Joel Santana, who becomes his manager.

videos.title: Are traveling
videos.overview: Valdo wants to travel, but Dona Jô remembers that he is not allowed to leave Meier. Sanderson embarks on Valdo's trip and says he wants to return to São Paulo.

videos.title: Ugly woman
videos.overview: Marli, the neighbor muambeira, appears at the pension with a lot of paraphernalia. Ferdinando baptizes his new guest as the cat with the seven veils, but she is a bitch.

videos.title: Call the manager
videos.overview: Tired of working so much, Dona Jô opens a vacancy for the manager of the pension. All residents decide to apply and the dispute becomes chaos.

videos.title: Bad habits
videos.overview: Dona Jô waits for a special visit and asks everyone to behave. As it could not be different, the guests do not obey and get ready with the arrival of Father Eusébio.

videos.title: Lgbtxyz
videos.overview: After a year of searching, Jaqueline arrives at the pension looking for Valdo, who is traveling. Ferdinando discovers that Jaqueline has changed teams and after revelations, Wilson declares himself a lesbian.

videos.title: Astral hell
videos.overview: A birthday party is organized to celebrate Terezinha's birthday. But Sanderson prepares the big surprise and invites Thiaguinho to do a show.

videos.title: Wooden
videos.overview: Valdo sets up a plan to earn money from a businessman who is going to lunch at the pension. He gets everyone's help, he just doesn't imagine that the tycoon doesn't have any more money.

videos.title: It seems but it is not
videos.overview: Terezinha and Velna spread the rumor that Sanderson is gay and was seen with Miltinho. But it's not Miltinho that Sanderson is going out with.

videos.title: It's Time!
videos.overview: Lacraia reappears at the pension, but he is now a graffiti artist and wanted by the police. Bruce Buffer arrives at the inn looking for the fighters Valdo said he was going to get.

videos.title: Gossip
videos.overview: Pathy dos Reis is a gossip blogger and appears at the pension behind Valdo. Eager to discover the residents' secrets and release her verb on the hammock, she causes discomfort in the house.

videos.title: Beggars
videos.overview: Guests are impressed when Eloisa tells how a beggar paid the taxi fare. They think that becoming a beggar can be the solution to their financial problems.

videos.title: Blackout
videos.overview: About to take the coup from the chest, Velna makes a date with a millionaire. A blackout ends everyone's joy. But Velna's tycoon can solve that problem.

videos.title: When the animal catches
videos.overview: Terezinha is invited to be the lady of Morro do Cerol again. However, she doesn't suspect that Raposo has his eye on her inheritance, which would be buried in the pension.

videos.title: "Tubaroa"
videos.overview: Ferdinando receives mail from Toninho Tubarão, Meier's dangerous moneylender. The pensioners despair and try to help Ferdinando pay off the debt.

videos.title: "Sistas"
videos.overview: Sanderson takes off modeling work for Velna and Jessica tries to help out with her friend's hair. Valesca Popozuda plays Dr. Valeiévisi, a specialist in the Theory of Shoulder Resistance.

videos.title: Méier Music
videos.overview: Dona Jô's pension competes to be the setting for MC Guimê's video. But the singer is disappointed to note that the place has nothing to do with the photos posted on Jessica's blog.

videos.title: Dotadão of Meier
videos.overview: A video of a man well served by nature causes an uproar in Meier. At the pension, because of the strange look and unexpected manners, suspicion falls on Wilson.

videos.title: Rainbow Inn
videos.overview: Bicha Bichérrima arrives at the pension after taking Ferdinando's place as the star of Quinta Gay. The two unite and have the idea of transforming the inn into an anti-prejudice HQ.

videos.title: Canta Forte Canta Alto
videos.overview: Maicol decides to launch Jaqueline in her musical career. On the opening day, Jaqueline goes hoarse and a resident of the inn introduces herself in her place.

videos.title: Optimized inn
videos.overview: Lindolfo Tigra promises worlds and funds to the pensioners. He takes an interest in Velna and invites her to make a commercial. But, he's a big lier and wants to make it right on top.

videos.title: The W archive
videos.overview: Your Wilson tries to contact extraterrestrials. Tomorrow, he appears without remembering anything. Jessica soon concludes that he was abducted and paranormal phenomena scare the inn.

videos.title: The clueless
videos.overview: Velna overindulges in the drink and is left with a millionaire he doesn't remember. A clueless guy shows up at the inn and tries to convince Velna that he's her prince charming.

videos.title: Divorce
videos.overview: Jessica breaks up with Maicol for being together for five days. Angered, he threatens to take as many women as possible. Jessica accepts the challenge and they make a bet.

videos.title: Take That The Son Is Yours
videos.overview: Valdisney arrives at the inn saying he is Valdo's son. Meanwhile, Ferdinando has a psychological pregnancy and Terezinha feels obliged to adopt after a dream about Tiziu.

videos.title: The favorite
videos.overview: The hill is at war, but Terezinha needs to pick up the costume of godmother of drums from Unidos do Cerol. She tries to convince Velna to take up the costume and ends up losing her post.

videos.title: Nêga Maluca
videos.overview: Ivonete appears at the inn saying that she is the real widow of Tiziu and asks for part of the inheritance. Terezinha decides to make her rival disappear with Velna's help.

videos.title: Past Life Therapy
videos.overview: Valdo plots another coup with the help of Eloisa invites the magician Roni. He pretends to be a Pai de Santo to deceive the residents of the inn. Velna ends up unraveling the scam.

videos.title: Who Touched My Pudding
videos.overview: Everyone gets excited when Dona Jô decides to make the pudding. But, the pudding disappears from the refrigerator and Mr. Wilson is responsible for the investigation.

videos.title: Hey Niggaz
videos.overview: Toninho Tubarão wants to know who said he dressed up as a woman. He threatens to kill everyone and suspicion falls on Terezinha and she decides to disguise herself as a rapper.

videos.title: Muscled Leg
videos.overview: A friend from Leblon's time, Demian Maia arrives in Meier to be a judge in a competition. Valdo has plans to go to Las Vegas with the MMA fighter. But Maicol disrupts everything.

videos.title: Episódio 1
